data.body: Post-merge evidence (2026-11-03 PST). On merged 0e7401446c5: make typecheck exit 0; pytest tests/unit/reconciler/ 3690 passed. First scheduled reconcile-bridge run after the merge, 41738990838 (started 15:25 PST, head 0e7401446c5), concluded success and logged 'Published rebar/host:bridge_run_failures=0'. Alarm rebar-bridge-run-failures is OK. Counter-evidence, recorded so the closure is not over-read: the alarm returned to OK at 14:35 PST, BEFORE the merge, because scheduled run 41730657245 (14:25 PST, pre-fix head a115c2edacd) succeeded; 41721586225 (13:25 PST, pre-fix) failed. So the failure was intermittent (4 of 5 pre-fix runs 10:25-14:25 PST failed), consistent with a latency-dependent lazy fetch near the 5 s bound, and one post-merge success does not by itself prove the fix; the unit tests pin the budget the fix changes. Still unexplained: why the failures began at 10:25 PST.
